title: Three days off
setting: A weekday afternoon. Sora gets back to the flat he shares with Kenta after a morning shift at the café and is surprised to find Kenta at home in the middle of the working week.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.romaji: are? kenta, kyou shigoto yasunda no? kaze?
lines.ja: あれ？ケンタ、今日仕事休んだの？風邪？
lines.kana: あれ？けんた、きょうしごとやすんだの？かぜ？
lines.english: Huh? Kenta, did you take today off work? Have you got a cold?

lines.speaker: kenta
lines.romaji: uun, kaze ja nai yo. kyou kara mikka, yasumi totta n da.
lines.ja: ううん、風邪じゃないよ。今日から三日、休み取ったんだ。
lines.kana: ううん、かぜじゃないよ。きょうからみっか、やすみとったんだ。
lines.english: No, it's not a cold. I've taken three days off, starting today.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.romaji: e, mikka mo? kenta ga yasumi toru no, hajimete ja nai? dou shita no?
lines.ja: え、三日も？ケンタが休み取るの、初めてじゃない？どうしたの？
lines.kana: え、みっかも？けんたがやすみとるの、はじめてじゃない？どうしたの？
lines.english: What, three whole days? Isn't this the first time you've ever taken time off? What's going on?

lines.speaker: kenta
lines.romaji: saikin shigoto ga sugoku isogashikute, hiru no kyuukei mo torenakatta n da.
lines.ja: 最近仕事がすごく忙しくて、昼の休憩も取れなかったんだ。
lines.kana: さいきんしごとがすごくいそがしくて、ひるのきゅうけいもとれなかったんだ。
lines.english: Work's been really busy lately. I couldn't even take my lunch break.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.romaji: kyuukei mo? boku nanka, baito de ichijikan ni ikkai wa kyuukei totteru yo.
lines.ja: 休憩も？僕なんか、バイトで一時間に一回は休憩取ってるよ。
lines.kana: きゅうけいも？ぼくなんか、ばいとでいちじかんにいっかいはきゅうけいとってるよ。
lines.english: Not even a break? Me, I take a break at least once an hour at my job.

lines.speaker: kenta
lines.romaji: sora wa torisugi. de, sengetsu, mae no seki no hito ga kaisha yameta n da.
lines.ja: ソラは取りすぎ。で、先月、前の席の人が会社辞めたんだ。
lines.kana: そらはとりすぎ。で、せんげつ、まえのせきのひとがかいしゃやめたんだ。
lines.english: You take way too many. Anyway, last month the person who sits in front of me quit.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.romaji: aa, sore de isogashii n da.
lines.ja: ああ、それで忙しいんだ。
lines.kana: ああ、それでいそがしいんだ。
lines.english: Oh, so that's why you're so busy.

lines.speaker: kenta
lines.romaji: un. sono hito no shigoto mo, zenbu boku ga yatteru n da.
lines.ja: うん。その人の仕事も、全部僕がやってるんだ。
lines.kana: うん。そのひとのしごとも、ぜんぶぼくがやってるんだ。
lines.english: Yeah. I'm doing all their work as well.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.romaji: uwa, taihen jan. sore wa kenta mo kaisha yametaku naru yo ne.
lines.ja: うわ、大変じゃん。それはケンタも会社辞めたくなるよね。
lines.kana: うわ、たいへんじゃん。それはけんたもかいしゃやめたくなるよね。
lines.english: Ugh, that's rough. No wonder you'd want to quit too.

lines.speaker: kenta
lines.ja: まあ、ちょっとだけ考えた。
lines.kana: まあ、ちょっとだけかんがえた。
lines.english: Well, I did think about it. A little.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.romaji: e, dame dame! kenta ga kaisha yametara, kono heya dou suru no?
lines.ja: え、だめだめ！ケンタが会社辞めたら、この部屋どうするの？
lines.kana: え、だめだめ！けんたがかいしゃやめたら、このへやどうするの？
lines.english: What? No, no, no! If you quit your job, what happens to this flat?

lines.speaker: kenta
lines.romaji: soko? daijoubu, kaisha wa yamenai yo. dakara yasumi totta n da.
lines.ja: そこ？大丈夫、会社は辞めないよ。だから休み取ったんだ。
lines.kana: そこ？だいじょうぶ、かいしゃはやめないよ。だからやすみとったんだ。
lines.english: That's what you're worried about? Relax, I'm not quitting. That's why I took the time off.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.romaji: yokatta. jaa, mikka mo shigoto yasunde, nani suru no?
lines.ja: よかった。じゃあ、三日も仕事休んで、何するの？
lines.kana: よかった。じゃあ、みっかもしごとやすんで、なにするの？
lines.english: Phew. So what are you going to do with three whole days off work?

lines.speaker: kenta
lines.romaji: gohan tsukutte, sakkaa mite, yukkuri neru.
lines.ja: ご飯作って、サッカー見て、ゆっくり寝る。
lines.kana: ごはんつくって、さっかーみて、ゆっくりねる。
lines.english: Cook, watch football, and get a good long sleep.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.romaji: ii naa. boku mo ashita, shigoto yasumou kana.
lines.ja: いいなあ。僕も明日、仕事休もうかな。
lines.kana: いいなあ。ぼくもあした、しごとやすもうかな。
lines.english: Lucky you. Maybe I'll take tomorrow off work too.

lines.speaker: kenta
lines.romaji: dame. sora wa mainichi kyuukei torisugi desho.
lines.ja: だめ。ソラは毎日休憩取りすぎでしょ。
lines.kana: だめ。そらはまいにちきゅうけいとりすぎでしょ。
lines.english: No way. You take far too many breaks every day as it is.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.romaji: kyuukei to yasumi wa chigau yo!
lines.kana: きゅうけいとやすみはちがうよ！
lines.english: A break and a day off aren't the same thing!

lines.speaker: kenta
lines.romaji: hai hai. jaa ashita chanto shigoto ittara, oishii gohan tsukuttoku yo.
lines.ja: はいはい。じゃあ明日ちゃんと仕事行ったら、おいしいご飯作っとくよ。
lines.kana: はいはい。じゃああしたちゃんとしごといったら、おいしいごはんつくっとくよ。
lines.english: Yeah, yeah. Tell you what: if you actually go to work tomorrow, I'll have a nice dinner waiting.

choices.english: Kenta has caught a cold and is off work, so Sora decides to stay home tomorrow and look after him.
Kenta has quit his job because a coworker left, and Sora is worried about who will pay for the flat.
Kenta has booked three days off because work got too much; he thought about quitting, but he's staying.

questions.explanation: Line 2: it isn't a cold; Kenta has booked three days off starting today (kyou kara mikka, yasumi totta n da). Lines 4-8: work has been so busy he couldn't even take a lunch break, because the colleague in front of him quit and Kenta is doing that person's work too. Line 10: he admits he thought about quitting a little, but in line 12 he says kaisha wa yamenai yo, dakara yasumi totta n da: he's not quitting, and that's why he took the time off. A is wrong: Kenta says kaze ja nai (line 2), and Sora's idea of skipping work tomorrow (line 15) is turned down. B is wrong: the one who quit is the colleague (line 6); Sora only panics about the flat in line 11, after Kenta says he thought about it.

questions.english: You've got a cold and stayed home from work today. Kenta calls: "Want to go out to eat tonight?" Tell him you took today off work with a cold.
questions.ja: 今日の夜、ご飯行かない？
questions.kana: きょうのよる、ごはんいかない？
questions.answer: Say you missed work with shigoto o yasumu in the past: kyou kaze de shigoto yasunda n da. Work is the object (shigoto o, or just shigoto), not shigoto kara.

modelAnswers.romaji: gomen, kyou kaze de shigoto yasunda n da.
modelAnswers.ja: ごめん、今日風邪で仕事休んだんだ。
modelAnswers.english: Sorry, I took today off work with a cold.

modelAnswers.romaji: gomen ne. kaze hiite, kyou wa shigoto yasunda n da. mata kondo ne.
modelAnswers.ja: ごめんね。風邪ひいて、今日は仕事休んだんだ。また今度ね。
modelAnswers.english: Sorry. I've caught a cold and stayed off work today. Another time, OK?

questions.explanation: Staying away from work, sick or not, is shigoto o yasumu, with work as the object: Sora asks kyou shigoto yasunda no? kaze? (line 1), mikka mo shigoto yasunde (line 13) and shigoto yasumou kana (line 15). 'Off work' tempts shigoto kara yasumu, but kara is wrong here. A sudden sick day is yasumu rather than yasumi o toru, which is for days off you arrange. And careful with the sound-alike: shigoto yameta would mean you quit your job.

questions.english: You work on Fridays. Yuki says: "Hey, want to go on a trip together, starting next Friday?" Say yes, and that you'll take Friday off.
questions.ja: ねえ、来週の金曜日から、一緒に旅行行かない？
questions.kana: ねえ、らいしゅうのきんようびから、いっしょにりょこういかない？
questions.romaji: nee, raishuu no kin'youbi kara, issho ni ryokou ikanai?
questions.answer: Say you'll book the day off with yasumi o toru: jaa, kin'youbi wa yasumi toru yo. Not kyuukei, which is a short break during the working day.

modelAnswers.romaji: ii ne! jaa, kin'youbi wa yasumi toru yo.
modelAnswers.ja: いいね！じゃあ、金曜日は休み取るよ。
modelAnswers.english: Sounds great! I'll take Friday off, then.

modelAnswers.romaji: iku iku! kin'youbi, yasumi toreru ka kaisha ni kiite miru ne.
modelAnswers.ja: 行く行く！金曜日、休み取れるか会社に聞いてみるね。
modelAnswers.english: I'm in! I'll ask work if I can get Friday off.

questions.explanation: Days off that you arrange with work are yasumi o toru, as Kenta says in line 2 (kyou kara mikka, yasumi totta n da) and line 12 (dakara yasumi totta n da), and Sora in line 3 (kenta ga yasumi toru no, hajimete ja nai?). The o is usually dropped in casual speech. kyuukei o toru would be a few minutes' break inside a working day, like Kenta's lunch break in line 4. Taking time off is not yameru: kaisha yameru means quitting the job for good.

questions.english: Sora says he might take tomorrow off work too. Why does Kenta say no?
questions.ja: ケンタさんは、どうして「だめ」と言いましたか？
questions.kana: けんたさんは、どうして「だめ」といいましたか？
questions.romaji: kenta-san wa, doushite dame to iimashita ka?

choices.english: Sora already takes far too many short breaks at work every day.
Sora has already had too many days off from the café this month.
The café is too busy for Sora to stay home tomorrow.

questions.explanation: Line 16: sora wa mainichi kyuukei torisugi desho. kyuukei o toru is taking a short break during the working day, and in line 5 Sora boasted that he takes one at least once an hour (ichijikan ni ikkai wa kyuukei totteru). B mixes kyuukei up with yasumi: days off would be yasumi o toru, and that difference is exactly Sora's comeback in line 17 (kyuukei to yasumi wa chigau yo!). C: nobody says the café is busy; the busy workplace is Kenta's (lines 4 and 7).

questions.english: When Kenta admits he thought about quitting, Sora panics. What does he say?
questions.ja: ソラさんは何と言いましたか？
questions.kana: そらさんはなんといいましたか？
questions.romaji: sora-san wa nan to iimashita ka?

choices.english: If you head out of the office, what happens to this flat?
choices.romaji: kenta ga kaisha detara, kono heya dou suru no?

choices.english: If you quit your job, what happens to this flat?
choices.romaji: kenta ga kaisha yametara, kono heya dou suru no?

choices.english: If you take time off work, what happens to this flat?
choices.romaji: kenta ga kaisha yasundara, kono heya dou suru no?

questions.explanation: Line 11: kenta ga kaisha yametara, kono heya dou suru no? Leaving a job for good is kaisha o yameru, the same verb Kenta uses for his colleague in line 6 (kaisha yameta n da) and for himself in line 12 (kaisha wa yamenai yo). A is the 'leave the company' calque: kaisha o deru means walking out of the office building, to go home or out to lunch, not leaving the job. C, yasumu, sounds close to yameru but means staying off work for a while, which is what Kenta has actually done (yasumi totta, lines 2 and 12) and is no threat to the flat.
